```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

read_csv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  csv_df <- utils::read.csv(
    path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
  )
  if (nrow(csv_df) == 0) NULL else csv_df
}

dt <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tags$p(htmltools::em("No data.")))
  }
  DT::datatable(
    df,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}

global_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "global_stats.csv"))
deteriorated_usm <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "Deteriorated_USM.csv"))
```

## Global statistics

```{r}
#| echo: false
dt(global_stats)
```

## Deteriorated USMs

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(deteriorated_usm)) {
  cat("\n\n::: {.callout-note}\nNo deteriorated USM detected.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  print(htmltools::tagList(dt(deteriorated_usm)))
}
```
